decisions.decision: engine godot 4.7.2 (adapter godot-4) for the autonomous Phase-1 vertical slice
decisions.reason: Phase 1 chooses Godot 4.7.2 PC (ADR-009) because it is the only engine with a verified headless/build/capture path on this machine; a different engine is a new project/port, not a toggle.

decisions.decision: add mobile target after Android debug APK export
decisions.reason: Phase-5 mobile gate: signed arm64 debug APK built and package-verified; on-device launch not yet tested.
